name: Kamil Tylus
description: Projects, writing, and background of Kamil Tylus, data scientist and AI engineer.
intro: I'm working on LLM applications, thinking about how recent advancements in models' capabilities could be used in production.
Experimenting with different ways of using AI assistants to take on more ambitious projects or finish tasks faster.
about: I’m currently a Data Scientist at Verisk, based in Poland. I have a MSc degree in Computer Science from Jagiellonian University, where I focused on deep learning.
Over the last couple of years I've moved more towards the engineering side of ML, including LLMs.
